notes: Tourism office names, contacts and addresses follow official LGU, provincial tourism and Citizen's Charter sources where published; unverified details are null instead of invented.
Festival dates follow published municipal and provincial calendars where available. Festivals without a published annual schedule carry illustrative 2026-2027 dates for the capstone demonstration.
All events mirror status = 'approved', matching the seed SQL so guests can see them through RLS.
Coordinates for municipalities match the deployed geofence configuration; Cardona is corrected to the town centre (14.4369, 121.2480).

categories.description: Museums, galleries, petroglyphs, local artisans and heritage landmarks.

categories.name: Festival
categories.description: Town fiestas, Higantes Festival, Hamaka Festival and cultural parades.

categories.name: Food & Heritage
categories.description: Unique Rizal delicacies, suman, kasuy, bibingka and lakeside restaurants.

categories.name: Eco-Tourism & Nature
categories.description: Waterfalls, mountain trails, wind farms, caves and nature reserves.

categories.name: Civic & Community
categories.description: Municipal civic programs, heritage walks and community exhibits.

categories.name: Sports & Recreation
categories.description: Mountain biking trails, marathons and outdoor adventure activities.

tourism_office.name: Baras Municipal Tourism Office

tourism_office.name: Binangonan Municipal Tourism Office

tourism_office.name: Cainta Municipal Tourism, Culture and Arts Office (MTCAO)

tourism_office.name: Jalajala Municipal Tourism Office
tourism_office.address: National Road, Brgy. Special District, Jalajala, Rizal

municipalities.name: Morong

tourism_office.name: Morong Municipal Tourism Office

municipalities.name: Pililla

tourism_office.name: Pililla Municipal Tourism Office
tourism_office.address: M.A. Roxas St., Brgy. Bagumbayan, Pililla, Rizal

events.title: Higantes Festival 2026: Giants of San Clemente
events.description: Angono's iconic thanksgiving festival fills the Art Capital's streets with towering papier-mâché higantes, brass bands and water-splashing crowds in honor of San Clemente. The 2026 edition coincides with the town fiesta on November 22–23.
events.how_to_get_there: From Shaw Blvd or Cubao, take a UV Express or jeepney bound for Angono and alight at Angono Town Plaza. The parade route runs through the Poblacion streets around the municipal plaza.

events.title: SuMaKaH Festival 2027 (Maytime Festival)
events.description: Antipolo's month-long Maytime celebration of suman, mangga, kasoy and hamaka opens on May 1 with street dancing, food fairs and cultural performances. Local producers line Sumulong Park and the City Hall grounds for the whole month.
events.venue_name: Sumulong Park & Antipolo City Hall grounds
events.how_to_get_there: Take a UV Express or jeepney from Cubao or Ortigas bound for Antipolo Cathedral, then walk to Sumulong Park beside the City Hall.

events.title: Antipolo Pilgrimage & Cathedral Heritage Walk
events.description: A guided cultural walk through the National Shrine of Our Lady of Peace and Good Voyage, the centuries-old pilgrimage church that made Antipolo the Pilgrimage Capital of the Philippines. Includes a heritage briefing on the image's galleon voyages and the city's May pilgrimage season.
events.venue_name: National Shrine of Our Lady of Peace and Good Voyage, Antipolo
events.how_to_get_there: From the Antipolo Cathedral jeepney terminal, walk to the shrine; tricycles from Robinsons Antipolo also drop off at the cathedral.

events.title: Tromba Festival 2027
events.description: Baras honors Nuestra Señora de Turumba with a river procession (tromba) along the Baras River followed by street dancing and a community feast. One of Rizal's most distinctive fluvial fiestas.
events.how_to_get_there: From Antipolo or Tanay, ride a jeepney along Manila East Road and alight at Baras town proper; the procession starts at the Baras River.

events.title: St. Joseph Parish Heritage Day
events.description: Open-house heritage day at the 1686 Diocesan Shrine and Parish of St. Joseph, one of the oldest Baroque churches in Rizal, with guided tours of its retablo and church museum.
events.venue_name: Diocesan Shrine and Parish of St. Joseph, Baras
events.how_to_get_there: Jeepneys from Antipolo to Baras stop in front of the church; travel time is about 25 minutes.

events.title: Binalayan Festival 2027
events.description: Binangonan's "BINAngonan sa LAwa at kawaYAN" festival showcases bamboo crafts, lakeshore products and the town's fishing heritage through street dancing and trade fairs. Barangay delegations perform along the municipal grounds facing Laguna de Bay.
events.how_to_get_there: Take a Binangonan-bound jeepney or UV Express via Manila East Road and alight at Binangonan Municipal Hall.

events.title: Talim Island & Mt. Tagapo Community Trek
events.description: A community-guided day hike to Mt. Tagapo on Talim Island, with views over Laguna de Bay and a lakeside lunch of buro at kanduli prepared by island households.
events.venue_name: Binangonan Port to Talim Island (Brgy. Janosa jump-off)
events.how_to_get_there: Board a passenger banca at Binangonan Port for Talim Island (about 30 minutes), then register at the Brgy. Janosa jump-off for Mt. Tagapo.

events.title: SumBingTik Festival 2026
events.description: Cainta's kakanin festival named for suman, bibingka and latik, staged around the town's founding anniversary and the feast of Our Lady of Light. Expect week-long kakanin showcases, cooking demos and a grand parade.
events.venue_name: Cainta Municipal Grounds & Our Lady of Light Parish
events.how_to_get_there: From Ortigas, ride a Cainta-bound jeepney or UV Express along Ortigas Avenue Extension and alight at Cainta Junction; the municipal grounds are a short walk away.

events.title: Cainta Lenten Senakulo & Heritage Walk
events.description: A traditional Lenten senakulo staged by local parishes, paired with a heritage walk to the Bantayog ng mga Bayani memorial honoring the Hunters ROTC guerrillas of World War II.
events.venue_name: Bantayog ng mga Bayani & Our Lady of Light Parish grounds, Cainta
events.how_to_get_there: Jeepneys along A. Bonifacio Avenue stop at the parish; from Cainta Junction take a tricycle to the Bantayog.

events.title: Kaluskos Festival 2026
events.description: Cardona lights its handcrafted bamboo arches for the Kaluskos Festival, named for the kuskos sound of a bolo shaping bamboo. The first week of December brings street dancing, arch-lighting ceremonies and lakeshore food stalls.
events.how_to_get_there: From Binangonan or Morong, ride a jeepney to Cardona town proper; the bamboo arches line the Poblacion streets near the municipal hall.

events.title: Pagoda Festival sa Lawa 2027
events.description: A lakeside thanksgiving procession on Laguna de Bay, where a decorated pagoda carries the town's patron image while fishing families offer prayers for a bountiful catch.
events.how_to_get_there: Take a jeepney to Cardona Municipal Hall, then walk to the lakeshore where the pagoda procession boards.

events.title: D'Dalaylay Festival 2027
events.description: Jalajala's barangay and school groups parade in ingenious costumes for the feast of St. Michael the Archangel, filling the peninsula's main road with street dancing and live music.
events.venue_name: Jalajala Municipal Grounds & St. Michael the Archangel Parish
events.how_to_get_there: Ride a jeepney from Binangonan or Tanay to Jalajala Poblacion; the street dance passes the St. Michael the Archangel Parish.

events.title: Santong Lugar Pilgrimage & Dragon Fruit Farm Tour
events.description: A morning pilgrimage to the hillside Santong Lugar site linked to the image of Our Lady of Maulawin, followed by a dragon fruit and carabao-milk farm tour with Jalajala's agricultural cooperatives.
events.how_to_get_there: From Jalajala Poblacion, hire a tricycle to Brgy. Bagumbong and ask for the Santong Lugar trail; farm tours can be arranged at the municipal tourism office.

events.title: Sanrok sa Ringring Festival 2027
events.description: Morong celebrates its local D-to-R dialect with the Sanrok sa Ringring Festival, where "sandok" becomes sanrok and "dingding" becomes ringring. The town fiesta brings street dancing, heritage exhibits and a food fair around St. Jerome Parish.
events.how_to_get_there: Ride a Morong-bound jeepney via Manila East Road and alight at Morong Town Plaza; the festival grounds are beside St. Jerome Parish.

events.title: Commandancia Museum & Heritage Walk
events.description: A guided walk through the Museong Pambayan at the Commandancia, the former seat of the Distrito Politico-Militar de Morong, and the 1615 Chinese-Baroque St. Jerome Parish.
events.how_to_get_there: From Morong Town Plaza, walk two minutes to the Commandancia building beside St. Jerome Parish; tricycles from the public market also pass by.

events.title: Magsolangtan Festival 2027
events.description: Pililla's town fiesta and founding-anniversary celebration features street dancing, agri-tourism booths and lakeside concerts, with July 22 declared a special non-working day for the municipality.
events.how_to_get_there: Take a Pililla-bound jeepney from Tanay or Antipolo via Manila East Road and alight at the Pililla Municipal Hall.

events.title: Pililla Wind Farm & Lakeshore Viewing Tour
events.description: An afternoon at the Pililla Wind Farm ridge, where turbines overlook Laguna de Bay and the Pililla coastline, followed by a lakeside grilled-fish dinner.
events.how_to_get_there: From Pililla Poblacion, hire a tricycle to the wind farm viewing deck in Brgy. Halayhayin; sunset viewing is best from the lakeside ridge.

events.title: Pamitinan Festival 2026
events.description: Rodriguez commemorates the 1895 Katipunan meeting at Pamitinan Cave with a week of heritage treks, cultural shows and a trade fair at the foot of the Sierra Madre.
events.how_to_get_there: From Cubao or Marikina, ride a Rodriguez/Montalban-bound jeepney and alight at the Wawa terminal, then take a tricycle to the Pamitinan jump-off.

events.title: Wawa Gorge & Pamitinan Cave Heritage Trek
events.description: A guided trek through the Wawa Gorge limestone formations to Pamitinan Cave, the declared historical site of the 1895 Katipunan assembly, with a river-side picnic stop.
events.how_to_get_there: Take a jeepney to Rodriguez Poblacion then a tricycle to Brgy. Wawa; register at the Wawa tourism desk before the trek.

events.title: Kakanin Festival 2027
events.description: San Mateo's kakanin festival at the Diocesan Shrine of Our Lady of Aranzazu features floats and free samples of suman, puto, kutsinta, sapin-sapin, biko and bibingka after the fiesta Mass.
events.venue_name: Diocesan Shrine of Our Lady of Aranzazu, San Mateo
events.how_to_get_there: From Batasan or Marikina, ride a San Mateo-bound jeepney along Gen. Luna Avenue and alight at the Aranzazu Shrine.

events.title: Timberland Ridge Bike & Hiking Day
events.description: A community ride and hike across the Timberland Heights ridge, Rizal's long-running mountain-bike destination, with beginner and advanced trail groups and a ridge-top market.
events.how_to_get_there: From San Mateo Poblacion, take a tricycle to Timberland Heights; private vehicles may park at the Timberland clubhouse.

events.title: Hane Festival 2027
events.description: Tanay's founding-anniversary festival celebrating agri-eco tourism, arts and culture, named after the Tanayan expression "hane." Expect farm tours, cultural performances and a harvest fair across the municipal grounds.
events.how_to_get_there: Take a Tanay-bound jeepney or UV Express from Shaw Blvd or Cubao and alight at Tanay Public Market; the plaza is a short walk away.

events.title: Tanay Rodeo Festival 2027
events.description: A rodeo and agri-eco tourism festival tied to Tanay's January town fiesta, with cattle-herding exhibitions, horseback demonstrations and a livestock and produce fair.
events.how_to_get_there: From Tanay Public Market, take a tricycle to the Rodeo Arena near the municipal grounds.

events.title: Tinipak River & Daraitan Community Trek
events.description: A community-guided trek to the marble boulders and clear pools of Tinipak River in Brgy. Daraitan, with a Sierra Madre ridge viewpoint and locally prepared lunch.
events.how_to_get_there: From Tanay Public Market, ride a jeepney to Brgy. Daraitan (about 45 minutes), then register at the barangay tourism desk before hiking to Tinipak River.

events.title: Hamaka Festival 2027
events.description: Taytay's week-long Hamaka Festival celebrates hamba (woodwork), makina (sewing machines) and kabuhayan (livelihood) with a Tiangge fashion show, craft demonstrations and street dancing.
events.how_to_get_there: Take a Taytay-bound jeepney along Ortigas Avenue Extension and alight at Club Manila East / Taytay Tiangge; the municipal hall is walking distance.

events.title: Basaan sa Taytay 2027
events.description: The Feast of St. John the Baptist turns Taytay's Poblacion into a water-splashing celebration, with a morning procession from St. John the Baptist Parish and street revelry.
events.venue_name: St. John the Baptist Parish & Poblacion streets, Taytay
events.how_to_get_there: From Taytay Municipal Hall, walk to St. John the Baptist Parish; expect water splashing along the Poblacion route.

events.title: AMARA Festival 2027
events.description: Teresa's town fiesta honors St. Rose of Lima with a week of street dancing, adobe-and-marble craft exhibits and community cooking, under the AMARA name drawn from adobe, marmol and apog.
events.how_to_get_there: From Antipolo or Tanay, ride a jeepney to Teresa town proper and alight at the municipal hall.

events.title: Turumba sa Santa Rosa 2027
events.description: Costumed street dancers move from the Saint Rose of Lima Parish through Teresa's barangays in the Turumba devotion to the town's patroness, with an evening cultural program at the plaza.
events.venue_name: Saint Rose of Lima Parish, Teresa
events.how_to_get_there: Jeepneys from Antipolo pass along Teresa Poblacion; ask the driver to drop you at the Saint Rose of Lima Parish.

pois.name: Blanco Family Museum
pois.description: Home gallery of the Blanco family of painters, whose rural-life canvases document Angono's artistic heritage across generations.
pois.address: I. Mendoza St., Brgy. San Roque, Angono, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: From Angono Town Plaza, take a tricycle to I. Mendoza Street; the museum is signposted.

pois.name: Nemiranda Arthouse & Atelier Gallery
pois.description: Studio-gallery of Nemiranda, filled with murals, sculptures and paintings of Rizal's folklore and town life.
pois.address: 117 Doña Justa Subdivision, Brgy. San Vicente, Angono, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: Beside Balaw-Balaw Restaurant in Doña Justa Subdivision; five minutes by tricycle from the town plaza.

pois.name: Pinto Art Museum
pois.description: A hillside complex of Mediterranean-inspired galleries showing contemporary Philippine art, with gardens and a chapel.
pois.address: 1 Sierra Madre St., Grand Heights, Antipolo City
pois.how_to_get_there: From Antipolo Cathedral, take a tricycle to Grand Heights and ask for Pinto Art Museum; about 15 minutes.

pois.name: Antipolo Cathedral (National Shrine of Our Lady of Peace and Good Voyage)
pois.description: The pilgrimage church that gave Antipolo its title as the Pilgrimage Capital of the Philippines, home of the venerated Virgin of Antipolo.
pois.how_to_get_there: From the Antipolo jeepney terminal, walk to the cathedral along P. Burgos Street; tricycles also drop off at the plaza.

pois.name: Sumulong Park Suman, Mango & Kasoy Stalls
pois.description: Park-side stalls selling Antipolo's SuMaKaH specialties: suman, ripe mangoes and roasted kasuy.
pois.how_to_get_there: Beside Antipolo City Hall and Sumulong Park; walkable from the cathedral.

pois.name: Diocesan Shrine and Parish of St. Joseph (Baras Church)
pois.description: A 1686 Baroque church and diocesan shrine, one of the oldest in Rizal, with a restored retablo and church museum.
pois.how_to_get_there: Jeepneys from Antipolo to Baras stop in front of the church; about 25 minutes from Antipolo.

pois.name: Masungi Georeserve
pois.description: A protected limestone karst georeserve with rope-and-ladder trails, karst gardens and Sierra Madre views; visits are by guided reservation.
pois.how_to_get_there: Ride a jeepney or van along Marcos Highway toward Baras and alight at the Masungi trailhead; reservations are required before arrival.

pois.name: Santa Ursula Parish
pois.description: Binangonan's historic lakeside parish, the start of the town's Kalbaryo pilgrimage and a landmark of its Spanish-era town center.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Binangonan Municipal Hall, walk to the Poblacion parish; tricycles from the public market also pass by.

pois.name: Talim Island & Mt. Tagapo
pois.description: A lake island in Laguna de Bay with a community-managed trek to Mt. Tagapo and panoramic views of the lake and Rizal coastline.
pois.address: Brgy. Janosa, Talim Island, Binangonan, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: Board a passenger banca at Binangonan Port for Talim Island (about 30 minutes), then register at the Brgy. Janosa jump-off.
pois.entrance_fee: Boat fare and guide fees apply

pois.name: Talim Island Buro at Kanduli Stalls
pois.description: Lakeside stalls serving buro, the fermented pink rice-fish preparation traditional to Talim Island, paired with fried kanduli.
pois.address: Binangonan Port, Brgy. Libid, Binangonan, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: Walk or take a short tricycle ride from Binangonan Poblacion to the port area; the stalls line the banca landing.

pois.name: Our Lady of Light Parish (Cainta Church)
pois.description: The centuries-old parish church of Cainta and the devotional center of the SumBingTik and Lenten traditions.
pois.address: A. Bonifacio Ave., Brgy. Sto. Domingo, Cainta, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: Jeepneys along Ortigas Avenue Extension stop near Cainta Junction; the church is a short walk along A. Bonifacio Avenue.

pois.name: Bantayog ng mga Bayani (Hunters ROTC Memorial)
pois.description: A sculptural memorial honoring the Hunters ROTC guerrillas, a key WWII resistance group organized in Rizal.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Cainta Junction, take a tricycle to the municipal grounds; the memorial stands beside the municipal hall.

pois.name: Aling Kika's Bibingka
pois.description: A Cainta institution for sticky-rice bibingka topped with latik, the delicacy behind the town's reputation as Rizal's bibingka capital.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Cainta Junction, walk to the public market and look for the Aling Kika's stall.

pois.name: Cardona Rock Garden
pois.description: A lakeside field of large naturally shaped boulders, cited as one of Rizal's unique geological sites and a favorite sunset stop.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Cardona Municipal Hall, take a tricycle toward the lakeshore and ask for the Rock Garden.

pois.name: Cardona Lakeshore & Fishing Village
pois.description: A working fishing village on Laguna de Bay where visitors can buy fresh catch and watch traditional lake fishing methods.
pois.how_to_get_there: Take a jeepney to Cardona Poblacion, then a tricycle to Brgy. Looc lakeshore.

pois.name: Santong Lugar
pois.description: A hillside pilgrimage site in Brgy. Bagumbong linked to the image of Our Lady of Maulawin, with Stations of the Cross and lake views.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Jalajala Poblacion, hire a tricycle to Brgy. Bagumbong and ask for the Santong Lugar trail.
pois.operating_hours: Open daily; best visited in the morning

pois.name: St. Michael the Archangel Parish
pois.description: A 1733 stone church and the devotional center of Jalajala, where the D'Dalaylay Festival procession begins.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Jalajala Municipal Hall, walk to the Poblacion parish along the national road.

pois.name: Dragon Wellness Farm
pois.description: An agri-tourism farm producing white- and red-fleshed dragon fruit, with guided orchard walks and farm-fresh produce.
pois.how_to_get_there: Arrange a farm visit through the Jalajala Municipal Tourism Office; tricycles from Poblacion can take visitors to the farm.

pois.name: Museong Pambayan (Commandancia)
pois.description: The former seat of the Distrito Politico-Militar de Morong, now a municipal museum of the town's Spanish-era and revolutionary history.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Morong Town Plaza, walk two minutes to the Commandancia building beside St. Jerome Parish.

pois.name: Emma's Panciteria
pois.description: A long-running Morong eatery known for sinigang na kanduli and chuba, and a stop on the town's heritage food walk.
pois.how_to_get_there: Walk from Morong Town Plaza along T. Claudio Street; the panciteria is beside the heritage houses.

pois.name: Simbahan ng Pililla (St. Mary Magdalene Parish)
pois.description: A 1670s stone church with an NHCP historical marker, one of the oldest parishes on the Laguna de Bay shoreline.
pois.address: M.A. Roxas St., Brgy. Bagumbayan, Pililla, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: From Pililla Municipal Hall, walk along M.A. Roxas Street to the church.

pois.name: Pililla Wind Farm
pois.description: A ridge-top wind farm of tall turbines overlooking Laguna de Bay, Talim Island and the Pililla coastline, popular for sunset viewing.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Pililla Poblacion, hire a tricycle to the wind farm viewing deck in Brgy. Halayhayin.

pois.name: Bahay na Bato ng Pililla
pois.description: A Spanish-era stone-and-timber house beside the parish church, used as a filming location and preserved as a heritage landmark.
pois.address: Beside St. Mary Magdalene Parish, Pililla, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: The house stands beside the parish church in Brgy. Bagumbayan; walk from the municipal hall.

pois.name: Pamitinan Cave & Wawa Gorge
pois.description: A limestone cave within the Pamitinan Protected Landscape, declared a historical site for the 1895 Katipunan assembly led by Andres Bonifacio.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Rodriguez Poblacion, take a tricycle to Brgy. Wawa and register at the Wawa tourism desk; guides are required for the cave.

pois.name: Avilon Zoo
pois.description: One of the country's largest zoological parks, home to Philippine and exotic wildlife in a forested Sierra Madre foothill setting.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Rodriguez Poblacion, take a tricycle or jeepney to Brgy. San Isidro and ask for Avilon Zoo.

pois.name: Diocesan Shrine of Our Lady of Aranzazu
pois.description: The Marian shrine of San Mateo and the center of its September Kakanin Festival, drawing pilgrims from across Rizal and Metro Manila.
pois.address: Gen. Luna Ave., Brgy. Guitnang Bayan I, San Mateo, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: Ride a San Mateo-bound jeepney along Gen. Luna Avenue and alight at the Aranzazu Shrine.

pois.name: Timberland Heights Bike Trails
pois.description: A ridge trail network above San Mateo used for mountain biking, trail running and hiking, with views toward Metro Manila.
pois.how_to_get_there: From San Mateo Poblacion, take a tricycle to Timberland Heights; private vehicles may park at the clubhouse.

pois.name: San Mateo Kakanin Stalls
pois.description: Market stalls selling the kakanin celebrated by the town's festival: puto, kutsinta, sapin-sapin, biko and puto-bungbong.
pois.address: San Mateo Public Market, San Mateo, Rizal
pois.how_to_get_there: From the Aranzazu Shrine, take a tricycle to the public market; the kakanin stalls are in the market's food section.

pois.name: Tinipak River & Daraitan
pois.description: A clear river framed by white marble boulders in Brgy. Daraitan, reached by a community-guided trek through Sierra Madre foothills.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Tanay Public Market, ride a jeepney to Brgy. Daraitan (about 45 minutes), then register at the barangay tourism desk.
pois.operating_hours: Day trips; register at barangay desk

pois.name: Regina RICA
pois.description: The Regina Rosarii Institute for Contemplation in Asia, a hilltop pilgrimage and contemplation center with a giant Dominican statue and gardens.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Tanay Poblacion, take a tricycle or jeepney toward Brgy. Sampaloc and ask for Regina RICA.

pois.name: Tanay Highlands Coffee & Suman Stalls
pois.description: Roadside and market stalls selling Tanay's highland coffee, suman, kalamay and kasoy produced in the Sierra Madre foothills.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Tanay Municipal Hall, walk to the public market; coffee and kakanin stalls line the highway approach.

pois.name: St. John the Baptist Parish
pois.description: Taytay's historic parish church and the starting point of the June 24 Basaan water-splashing feast.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Taytay Municipal Hall, walk to the Poblacion parish; tricycles from the tiangge also pass by.

pois.name: Taytay Woodworks & Hamaka Craft Shops
pois.description: Workshops and showrooms producing Taytay's carved furniture, home decor and garments, the "hamba" and "makina" behind the Hamaka Festival.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Taytay Municipal Hall, take a tricycle to the woodworks shops along Manila East Road; ask for the Hamaka craft strip.

pois.name: Saint Rose of Lima Parish
pois.description: The camalig-style parish church of Teresa and the center of the Turumba devotion to St. Rose of Lima.
pois.how_to_get_there: Jeepneys from Antipolo pass along Teresa Poblacion; ask the driver to drop you at the parish.

pois.name: Rancho Bravo (Bravo's Farm)
pois.description: A farm-tourism destination with animals, trekking paths and pools set against Teresa's limestone hills.
pois.how_to_get_there: From Teresa Poblacion, hire a tricycle to Brgy. Dalig and ask for Rancho Bravo.

pois.name: Sarian Farm
pois.description: A working farm and garden destination in Teresa offering orchard walks, farm produce and hillside views.
pois.how_to_get_there: Arrange the visit through the Teresa Municipal Tourism Office; tricycles from Poblacion can take visitors to the farm.
